div.style: font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; border-left: 2px solid #F47067; padding: 4px 0 4px 14px;
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: Self-hosted portal for anything that gets submitted, reviewed in turn and decided. The process graph, the forms and the emails are all drawn in the admin UI, never written in code.
